title: Review of c42's held-out arena-size finding on fresh seed 13: Supported. L=80 coexists (prey at 100% of late frames, 11 predators at the end); L=40 coexists narrowly (prey at 62%), within the finding's L=40 rate of 1/4 and its prediction of <= 2/4
summary: Labkit runs of the food-chain world.py (unchanged) at L=80 and L=40 on unused seed 13 (t=12000), scored with the same coexistence rule as c42 (coexist.py: predators at every frame from t=6000, prey at >= 50% of them, components >= 10 px in the normalized render). L=80: both kinds present throughout, 4 prey and 11 predators at the end. L=40: predators present throughout, prey at 62% of late frames, 0 prey at t=12000, so it passes the rule narrowly. One seed per size cannot test a rate, but neither run contradicts the rising coexistence fraction with area.

observations.X: coexist.txt: L80 s13 coexist (prey 100% of late frames, 11 predators at t=12000); L40 s13 coexist by the rule (prey 62%, predators throughout)

seeds_run.result: L80 coexist (consistent); L40 coexist narrowly (consistent with 1/4 to 2/4)

controls_run.X: arena size L=80 vs L=40 on seed 13

verdicts.limitation: One seed per size, so this checks consistency, not the rates; my counter uses labkit's normalized render rather than drive.py.
